data.one_liner: Load environment variables at runtime from a .env file.
data.what_it_does: Parses a .env file to load configuration values into your application at runtime. It can optionally merge these values with the built-in Platform.environment map and supports variable substitution.
use_when: You need to store configuration in environment variables per the twelve-factor app methodology.
You want to mimic a production environment during local development using a .env file.
avoid_when: You require compile-time environment configuration injected via dart --define.
You need secure persistent key-value device storage for user data.
strengths: Easy to configure with support for multiple file paths and variable substitution.
Includes a command-line interface helper to initialize and test .env files.
weaknesses: Does not expose the underlying map directly since version 4.0.0, requiring forwarding methods.
Does not inject variables at compile time.
data.setup_notes: Create a .env file in your project and optionally add it to your .gitignore.

alternatives.name: cli_config
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative approach for loading CLI configuration and settings.
